tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Use this when someone without a Capital Company account wants one for their firm. Opens a Capital Company workspace, an account and the firm’s team. Needs no sign-in. Capital Company emails them a sign-in link.

tools.name: capital_company_create_fund
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to set up an SPV or a fund — to pool investors’ money into one deal, such as buying a startup’s or a pre-IPO company’s shares, or to raise a blind pool — or asks how to start one. Starts setting up the fund in Capital Company: an SPV or a blind pool, with its legal name,

tools.name: capital_company_invite_investors
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to bring investors into one of their funds. Starts an invitation of investors to the fund by email address. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed invitations for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_send_subscription_agreements
tools.description: Use this when the user wants investors in one of their funds to sign their subscription agreements. Starts the signature requests. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed signature requests for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_send_capital_calls
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a fund’s investors to pay in money they committed. Starts capital call notices to the investors of a fund class. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed notices for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing, and Capital Company never moves money.

tools.name: capital_company_update_fund
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a setting on one of their funds. Starts a change to the settings they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_edit_commitment
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change an investor’s existing commitment in one of their funds. Starts an edit to the fields they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed edit, with its effect on capital calls already sent, for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_create_commitment
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to record that an investor committed to one of their funds. Starts recording the new commitment. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed commitment for the user to confirm. This call records nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_create_invite_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a link they can share so that investors can ask to join a class of one of their funds. Starts a new shareable invite link, with a label and an expiry if they give one. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed link for the user to confirm; once confirmed,

tools.name: capital_company_update_invite_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to rename a shareable invite link to one of their funds or change when it expires. Starts the change. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_revoke_invite_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a shareable invite link to one of their funds to stop working. Starts revoking it. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed revocation for the user to confirm. This call revokes nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_set_invite_link_fees
tools.description: Use this when the user wants investors who join through a shareable invite link to start on different fees. Starts setting the link’s fees: the class’s default, another template, or new terms. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed fees for the user to confirm. This call changes no

tools.name: capital_company_add_fund_class
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a new class in one of their existing funds, with its own fees or commitment limits. Starts adding the class. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed class for the user to confirm. This call creates nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_edit_fund_class
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a class of one of their funds: its name, commitment limits, unit price, fees or admin fee reserve. Starts the change to the terms they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change for the user to confirm. This call changes nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_update_capital_call
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a capital call already made in one of their funds: its deadline or notes, or one investor’s amount. Starts the change. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed change, with each investor’s amount before and after and whether they are emailed, fo

tools.name: capital_company_resend_capital_call
tools.description: Use this when the user wants investors reminded of a capital call they have not paid in full. Starts a reminder of the call’s notice to the investors they name, or every investor with something outstanding. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed reminders with their recipients for

tools.name: capital_company_cancel_capital_call
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to cancel a capital call in one of their funds that nobody has paid. Starts the cancellation. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed cancellation, with what the investors are told, for the user to confirm. This call cancels nothing, and Capital Company

tools.name: capital_company_remind_to_sign
tools.description: Use this when the user wants investors in one of their funds reminded to sign the subscription agreement they were already sent — the ones they name, or everyone who has not signed. Starts the reminders. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed reminders, with who is left out and why

tools.name: capital_company_resend_fund_invitations
tools.description: Use this when the user wants invitations to one of their funds sent again to the investors already invited. Starts resending them to the addresses each invitation is out to. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed invitations to resend for the user to confirm. This call sends nothin

tools.name: capital_company_withdraw_fund_invitations
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to withdraw invitations to one of their funds that nothing has come of yet — one sent to the wrong person or sent twice. Starts withdrawing the ones they name; an investor who has a commitment, was sent a subscription agreement, or has a capital call or payment is not wi

tools.name: capital_company_approve_investor_kyc
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to approve the KYC questionnaire an investor submitted to one of their funds. Starts the approval of the questionnaires they name. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed approvals, with any issues flagged on each questionnaire, for the user to confirm.

tools.name: capital_company_ask
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their own funds on Capital Company, or how Capital Company works. Answers a question about the user’s team and funds from Capital Company’s records, or about how Capital Company works — where something is, what a page, a status or an email means, what the product of

tools.name: capital_company_reply
tools.description: Sends the user’s answer to Capital Company’s last question, in their own words. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or a proposal for the user to confirm.

tools.name: capital_company_confirm
tools.description: Sends the user’s answer, confirm or decline, to a Confirmation from Capital Company. Confirming carries out what it describes; declining carries out nothing, and Capital Company asks what to change.

tools.name: capital_company_show_confirmation
tools.description: Shows a Confirmation from Capital Company on its card, where the user can confirm or decline it. Changes nothing.

tools.name: capital_company_claim
tools.description: For someone without a Capital Company account who said yes to a proposal: emails a sign-in link to the address they give. Opening the link verifies the address and creates what they said yes to.

tools.name: capital_company_conversation
tools.description: Reads the user’s current conversation with Capital Company, including the outcome of anything they confirmed and whether it is waiting on them. Changes nothing.
